# E-22 step 3: the matrix (generated by verify/summarize.py from verify/results/)

Seeds per cell: 100 (core-determinism: 100 seeds, each run twice). calm = no leader change, move or message loss, shuffle off; faults = the check's own faults plus one forced leader change and one forced slot move aimed at a write in flight, shuffle off; shuffle = faults with TEST-12's shuffle on. In flight = seeds where a leader change (LC) or a move overlapped a client operation on the same resource. Porcupine = per-partition histories of every mode together. Direct = exactly-once, refusals, acks in the log, committed entries kept, fencing (log and real time), session order.
